summary: AIROUTER-01 Phase 2 (Software Team L0-L5 + Instruction Contract + routing matrix) is architecture-sound, correct, and secure, and all quality gates pass: bunx tsc --noEmit 0 errors, bun run lint 0 errors (same 3 pre-existing warnings, none introduced), full bun test 1814 pass / 0 fail. The implementation is genuinely additive and backward-compatible: softwareTeamLevel is opt-in, every new branch is guarded by if(softwareTeamLevel), and the new capability-category axis in mother-router.ts is always still gated through checkTierEligibility() (never a guardrail bypass — verified computeSoftwareTeamResolution runs every override candidate through the tier gate and falls back to baseline on ineligibility). The Instruction Contract/Execution Report schema matches the Owner's 4 worked examples exactly (used as regression fixtures), and the multi-step aggregation logic (workflow-level status=FAIL if any step failed, min confidence, summed execution_summary, first-step objective retained, expectedSteps-gated 'completed') is internally consistent. Tier/level/category consistency is fail-closed at 422 before any model call, the retry loop injects the matched failure signal rather than bare re-rolling, and the route is veridian_admin-gated via requireAuth() with all DB access through parameterized Drizzle queries. The disclosed GPT-OSS-120B->DeepSeek divergence is correctly reasoned (naming an INTEGRATIVE-ineligible model would silently fall back to the expensive GLM-5.2 baseline). Migrations are correctly ordered: 0249 references platform.ai_router_scope which exists by then (0245 moved it from compliance->platform schema; 0248 added customer_success). Disclosed, accepted limitations (non-atomic recordExecutionReport read-merge-write for concurrent same-taskId callers, since L2/L3 are sequential by contract; migration not applied to live DB as this is tier2-held; one low-priority test-mock where-clause gap) are reasonable Phase-1 disclosures, not blockers. The full 3-round GLM-5.2 independent-audit log is append-only and honestly records 6 blockers / 10 major / 14 minor findings with fixes, including one false finding investigated and confirmed false rather than silently accepted. No .github/workflows/** changes, so the hard rule in SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md is not triggered. tier2 (touches schema.ts + new drizzle .sql migrations) — approval means ready for human sign-off to merge, not autonomous merge.
